measured_by: parallel classification workflow (8 agents, 55 files) + independent heuristic cross-check
experiment_spec_fields: schema_family + spec_version (str): frozen family tag e.g. 'mop-starss23-escs/v2', drives prereg/artifact/verification schema strings the way the current per-bed *_SCHEMA constants do
stage (int): pipeline stage, e.g. 3
bed_id (str): stable identifier, replaces COUNT_BED_ID / doa bed_id constants
claim_scope (str, frozen invariant): 'deterministic programmatic mechanics only; no capability or natural-data claim'
question (str): the human-readable research question (count_prereg 'question' key)
dataset: DatasetContract(corpus_id, adapter_id, source_kind, rights_clean:bool, real_corpus:bool) — replaces the source_kind/rights_clean/real_corpus artifact keys and adapter wiring
split: SplitContract(rule='room_disjoint', fold_seed, disjointness_assertion:bool) — replaces schema.py room_disjoint_split declaration
unit: UnitContract(experimental_unit='clip', frame_ms=FRAME_MS, collar_frames:int|None) — carries claim_ceiling.experimental_unit and onset/DoA collar_frames
feature_providers: list[FeatureProviderRef(featurizer_id, expected_parameter_digest, expected_flops_per_frame)] — the axis's featurizer swap set (base, superflux, interchannel, spatial_doa, repro)
treatments: list[TreatmentRef(gate_id, arch_id)] — gate architectures/variants; carries the doa architectures[] and gate_variants lists
controls: list[ControlRef] = [rate_matched_random, always_on, never_update, noisy_tv, best_single, at_chance] — primary_control names the decisive one
budget: Budget(flop_ceiling, matched_budget_rule='matched_ex_training', operating_point_rule:str, break_even_model_id) — carries flop_ceiling, operating_point_rule, matched_budget, break_even keys

metric: Metric(name, metric_rule:str, direction:str, cold_start=0, scoring_unit='frame_micro_avg'|'clip_macro', scoring_geometry_id) — carries PREREG_METRIC, METRIC_RULE, PREREG_DIRECTION, COLD_START, scoring_unit

sesoi: Sesoi(value, provisional:bool, selection_method:str, cost_benefit=CostBenefitAnchors(c_train_flops=C_TRAIN_ANCHOR, c_reest_flops=FLOPS_PER_REESTIMATE, operating_reestimate_fraction)) — the SESOI=0.02 literal plus the three fixed FLOP/rho anchors that drive compute_count_cost_benefit
seeds: SeedPlan(n_paired_seeds=5, seed_root) — the N_PAIRED_SEEDS literal and seed-derivation root

decision_rule: DecisionRule(sign_flip='exact_one_sided_upper_tail', statistic='mean_paired_delta', alpha=0.05, two_sided_policy='unreachable_below_floor', dominance_rule='candidate_strictly_dominates_rate_matched_random') — carries sign_flip_test_plan and the harness dominance verdict
stop_rule: StopRule(promotion_bar:str, min_reproductions=3, single_run_never_promotes=True) — the promotion_bar string and MIN_REPRODUCTIONS
claim_ceiling: ClaimCeiling(claim_verb=BOUNDED_CLAIM_VERB, forbidden_verbs=FORBIDDEN_CLAIM_VERBS, frame_or_clip_bootstrap_allowed=False)
multiplicity: Multiplicity(kind='architectures'|'variants'|'none', members, correction) — carries the doa/gate_variants multiplicity block

reproduction: ReproductionAxis(axis_id, of_bed, override_field, override_value)|None — carries reproduction_axis/of_bed and the single swapped dimension (data_split | gate_arch | featurizer_estimator | scoring_unit)
invariants: {activation_allowed:false, scientific_promotion:false} — non-overridable engine constants
verification: VerifierContractRef(verifier_kit_id, tolerance=1e-9, expected_schemas, expected_arm_names) — the pure-data projection the independent verifier consumes
report_projection: ReportProjection(artifact_key_order) — declares which computed fields are serialized and in what canonical order (replaces the hand-maintained artifact_keys lists)
timestamp_source: 'caller_supplied' (never wall clock), preregistered_before_reading_test_scores:true — the honesty gate flags
shared_lifecycle_steps: 1. Resolve DatasetContract: corpus discovery via the one dataset adapter, emit the immutable room-disjoint SplitContract description and clip/room/frame unit metadata (replaces per-bed adapter+schema split plumbing)

2. Build-and-seal preregistration: run the declared cost-benefit -> SESOI derivation from fixed FLOP/rho anchors and structural label facts (never a test score), assemble the prereg body from the spec fields, compute canonical_sha256 self-seal, atomic_write_json; hard-gate that no test-split score has been read (build_prereg_body/self_seal/atomic_write_json, shared across all *_prereg.py)
3. Allocate paired seeds from the SeedPlan root (seed_split_plumbing / seed_derivation)
4. Resolve or build the feature cache: derive the cache key, self-seal the manifest, atomic canonical-JSON write, verify seal on load (replaces feature_cache*.py wholesale)

5. Featurize -> estimate orchestration: run each FeatureProvider then the Estimator to produce the per-clip shared estimator track E; controls and treatments differ only in the re-estimation set R (featurize_estimate_orchestration)

6. Run the matched-budget sweep: enumerate budget points under the flop_ceiling, train each Treatment gate, run every Control, execute per-seed runs, assemble budget-point candidates (run_matched_budget / per_seed_run_sweep / budget_point_assembly)

7. Budget accounting + decision: assert matched-ex-training FLOPs, compute break-even, build the Pareto frontier, evaluate the DecisionRule dominance verdict (matched_budget / gate_decision / pareto_frontier / break_even)
8. Referee scoring: invoke the axis Metric/scoring-geometry provider to produce per-seed/per-arm scores from E and each arm's R (build_report_body around a provider call)

9. Statistics: compute paired deltas, run the exact sign-flip permutation test, apply the SESOI check, construct the claim ceiling (paired_deltas / exact_sign_flip / sesoi_check / claim_ceiling_construction)
11. Assemble the artifact body in the ReportProjection canonical order, canonical_sha256 self-seal, atomic_write_json (build_artifact_body / self_seal / atomic_write_json)
12. Emit campaign status/progress and the Telegram summary (campaign status + progress reporting)

13. Independent-verify in a SEPARATE process: hand the verifier only the sealed artifact bytes + the pure-data VerifierContract projection; it re-derives and writes its own sealed verification artifact (the engine does not call it in-process)
provider_interfaces: FeatureProvider (carries front-end DSP math): featurize(audio)->ndarray, n_params()->int, parameter_digest()->str, feature_digest(features)->str, flops_for_frames(n)->int, plus module-level FLOPS_PER_FRAME. Exact current interface of featurizer_superflux_spectral / featurizer_spatial_doa / featurizer_interchannel_coherence / count_repro featurizer. Frozen, zero trained params, byte-reproducible.

Estimator (carries the WHAT re-estimation math): reestimate(features, frame)->value and FLOPS_PER_REESTIMATE. The count/doa estimators; produces the shared per-clip track E that every arm coasts from.

LabelProvider / ScoringGeometry (carries the task-specific label + metric geometry): targets_from_track (voc_targets_from_count_track, doa_voc_targets_from_track), and the decisive scorer coast_emitted / angular_error / great_circle_degrees / macro_pooled_score / room_majority_collapse. This is the single producer-side source of truth for grading one arm; it is what the engine's Metric step calls.

Treatment (carries the gate architecture math): fit(train_features, train_targets)->state, forward/infer causal pass, OnlineState.update / OnlineState.to_vector, param_count()->int, inference_flops()->int, training_flops()->int, parameter_digest()->str. The learning_progress / diversity_reg / recurrence_spread / refractory_nms / doa arch-A/arch-B gates.

Control (mostly shared, thin per-axis hook): fire(features, budget)->reestimate_set for rate_matched_random / always_on / never_update / noisy_tv / best_single / at_chance. Only the target-adapter (turning the axis track into control targets) is axis-specific; the fire policies live once in the engine.

Budget + FlopModel (mostly shared, per-axis constants): run_flops(work_vector), matched-budget certification, break_even_queries, per_query_saving_vs_always_on, pareto_frontier. The axis supplies only the flop-model constants; the accounting is shared.

StatProvider / DecisionRule / StopRule (shared math, DELIBERATELY re-implemented in the verifier): paired_deltas, exact_sign_flip (one-sided permutation), two_sided_alpha_reachable, sesoi_check, dominance verdict, promotion logic. Lives once in the engine for the producer and is independently re-coded in the verifier kit.
ReportProjection (no math): maps the computed result object to the canonical ordered artifact dict and back, replacing the hand-maintained artifact_keys lists.
verifier_independence: "Independence is preserved structurally, not by trust, exactly as count_verifier.py already does it, and the engine is designed so the collapse cannot erode it. (1) IMPORT ISOLATION: the verifier is a separate module run in a separate process that imports ONLY the standard library (json, hashlib, itertools, dataclasses, __future__). It imports nothing under mop, not the engine, not the ExperimentSpec object, not any FeatureProvider/Metric/Stat provider. A unit test parses the verifier's import surface and fails the build if it grows past the whitelist. (2) RE-DECLARATION: every constant the verifier needs (schema strings, arm names, cold_start, tolerance=1e-9, min_reproductions=3, allowed/forbidden claim verbs) is re-declared in the verifier, never imported, so it shares no symbol with the producer. (3) RE-DERIVATION NOT COMPARISON: the verifier re-computes the canonical seal, re-coasts every arm's track from the sealed E and per-arm R, re-scores the pooled metric, and re-enumerates the exact sign-flip permutation; the artifact's stored numbers are used only to compare against, never to compute. (4) DATA-ONLY BRIDGE: the ONE thing the engine hands the verifier is a pure-data VerifierContract = a JSON projection of the spec (schema strings, arm names, SESOI, seeds, cold_start, metric_rule text, tolerance, min_reproductions, claim verbs). No Python callable crosses the boundary, so there is no shared decisive scoring implementation. The mandate's rule is honored literally: shared neutral data schemas and the raw sealed artifact are acceptable; the engine's Metric/Stat providers are NOT reused by the verifier, so the verifier's ~1540 LOC of re-derivation math is preserved-by-design duplication, not collapsed. (5) TWO VERDICTS KEPT APART: independent_referee_reproduction (mechanics: seal intact, arithmetic re-derived, honesty flags false) and independent_scientific_confirmation (additionally real data, clean rights, control at chance, >=3 bias-independent reproductions). The verifier can never self-certify the second on a single run; that guardrail is unchanged by the collapse. The only sharing the engine may offer verifiers is a stdlib-only 'verifier kit' of NON-decisive scaffolding (seal-recompute helper, argparse runner, VerificationResult dataclass) which is itself import-isolated; the decisive re-scoring stays independently authored per axis."
